description: Use when writing or reviewing any PHP in a Dotkernel project — which PSR applies, how to type handlers and middleware (PSR-7/PSR-15), how to obtain services (PSR-11, no service locator), logging (PSR-3), caching (PSR-6/PSR-16), building responses (PSR-17), autoloading (PSR-4), and coding style (PSR-1/PSR-12 via the Laminas Coding Standard). Also use when phpcs or phpstan complains, or when tempted to type-hint a concrete framework class instead of an interface.
